translations.web: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
translations.bsb: They are confounded because they had hoped; their arrival brings disappointment.
translations.kjv: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
translations.asv: They were put to shame because they had hoped; They came thither, and were confounded.
